initial_full_failure.evidence: I have that one too, I cant stand the feeling so I always skip it.
initial_full_failure.observed: Habitual skipping supports actual routine non-use/discontinuation
initial_full_failure.judgment: Non-use/avoidance is supported; an actual transition/discontinuation from prior routine use is not narrated. Promoting this into completed replacement changes action completion and source count. Material first-pass overreach; full update correctly retracts it. Baseline final answers did not make it; no stochastic causal claim.

This membership is a defensible wider reading, not an unsupported behavioral event. Frozen wording/expected sets remain unchanged; experiment cannot claim all definition ambiguity eliminated.
